saySample.text: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with thick glasses returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a wiry build returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A woman, maybe 30s, with thick glasses settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 30s, with thick glasses.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 40s, with freckles came back with 649 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Ethan and Divya lingered over the fire together.
Sanne and Aroha lingered over the fire together.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 40s, with restless hands taught the woman in her 40s, with a crooked nose Steady Hands.
🤒 Gustavo is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. A person, maybe 40s, with freckles is already boiling water. It's handled.
Aria sits with Gustavo — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A person, maybe 40s, with freckles watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Enrique Alvarado reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 20s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Aroha," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Aroha." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Aroha).
...and then it lands: A person, maybe 30s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Enrique," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Enrique." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Enrique).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 40s, with freckles says. (Trust too low.)

🌿 A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~6 days of fresh on hand… leaves the fish nets standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands hauls back 4 wood. The pile grows. (14 logs now.)
💧 A person, maybe 20s returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 20s heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
Enrique heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
Aroha heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going."
A woman, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 20s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
🪨 A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (1 stone now.)

🐗⚠️ One of them is bigger than the usual teeth at the door — The Focus Group came with this raid, and the wall was not built for its kind.
